biotools.summary: survhive is a software package that facilitates the assessment of machine and deep learning methods for survival analysis, particularly in scenarios with non-proportional hazards and non-linear relationships. It offers code and documentation for reproducible testing on benchmark datasets, enabling users to evaluate different survival prediction methods.
